does: Coats a piece of food in a thin layer of flour just before it is fried, so that it browns evenly and does not stick.

intro.what: A piece of food receives a thin flour dusting immediately before frying.
intro.why: Excess flour and waiting change that dry film into a heavy damp layer. Timing matters as much as coverage.
intro.idea: A dry dusting just before frying

how: Dry the food and season it.
Lay it in a plate of flour and turn it to coat every side.
Lift it and tap off everything that does not cling.

cues.text: A thin, even, dusty coat, with the food still showing through it.

mistakes.mistake: Flouring ahead of time, so that the coat turns to a damp paste and fries gummy.
mistakes.fix: Flour at the last moment, when the fat is already hot.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving a thick coat on, which falls off in the pan and burns.

quiz.question: What is the flour layer intended to help with here?
choices: A thick flour layer intended to absorb as much fat as possible.
A thick protective flour layer left loose around the food.
Even browning and less sticking during frying.
quiz.because: The thin flour film treats the surface without adding a bulky loose layer.

quiz.question: What should happen after coating every side in flour?
choices: Tap off flour that does not cling.
Pack on more flour until the food is hidden.
Wet the flour coating before frying.
quiz.because: Removing loose flour keeps the intended dusting thin.

quiz.question: What should the dredged surface look like?
choices: A thick opaque ridge of loose flour.
A thin dusty film with the food showing through.
A wet paste running off the piece.
quiz.because: Seeing the food through the dusting indicates a light layer rather than excess flour.

quiz.question: The flour became a damp gummy paste while waiting. What would you change next time?
choices: Dredge earlier and leave it standing longer.
Wet the coated pieces before they wait.
Dredge when the pan is ready for frying.
quiz.because: Applying flour near the frying stage limits the time it has to absorb surface moisture.
